catalogEntry.name: Ball Killers™
catalogEntry.description: Self-defense you can wear to dinner. Glossy patent pumps with blood-red soles and tungsten-tipped points at heel and toe — as sexy on the dance floor as they are useful when someone needs a very direct lesson in boundaries.
features: Shiny black patent upper; blood-red lacquered sole
"ball" / "killer" printed on each shoe in bright red
Dual contact points — heel stem and toe — capped in tungsten
Stiletto geometry for maximum leverage (dry cleaning not included)
